title: feat(spec): a package-id segment may open with a digit, and the refusal states the rule the pattern enforces
body:
Fixes #19870

Clause-②: yes

Implements ruling `5807946372` on this card (maintainer, verbatim: 「19870 去掉」; re-graded p2 in `5808347937`), items 1 to 5, in the package-ID region of `manifest.zod.ts` / `manifest.test.ts` only. The VERSION-grammar hunks that draft PR #19637 carries in the same two files are untouched; a no-driver merge-tree probe of this head against `origin/main` `369bcbe` is clean.

## What changes

- **`MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN`** (`packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts`) becomes `/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*(\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)+$/` (item 1). Additive widening: every id legal before stays legal; `com.163.crm`, `com.example.2app` and `local.2024-app` become legal. Still refused: a hyphen-led segment, an underscore, upper case, a single segment, an empty segment.
- **The refusal sentence** (`manifestIdRefusal`) now reads `... Expected reverse-domain notation ('com.steedos.crm', 'org.apache.superset') — lowercase dot-separated segments of letters, digits and inner hyphens; a segment may not open with a hyphen; underscores are not admitted.` The pattern docblock loses 「Each segment starts with a letter」 and says why a digit may open a segment; the `id` TSDoc states the rule (item 2). `MANIFEST_ID_EXAMPLES` unchanged. A digit-led bare word now gets the prefixed repair (`2fa` gets `Did you mean 'com.example.2fa'?`), where it used to get none.
- **Pins** (item 3), `manifest.test.ts`: one `ACCEPTED` / `REFUSED` table. `com.example.2app` moved to accepted with `com.163.crm` beside it; each accepted row asserts the id parses to itself. `com.example.-app`, `com.example.my_app` and `Com.Example.App` stay refused, each asserting `invalid_format` and the declaration's own sentence. The `PackageSchema.manifestId` door is judged once on the same table, the expected verdict read from the table and never from the pattern. One more pin: the sentence names digits and the leading-hyphen rule and states no leading-letter clause.
- **`manifest.namespace` is untouched** (item 4). Its leading-letter rule stays for the SQL-identifier reason.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` **minor** (item 5), `.changeset/19870-manifest-id-digit-led-segment.md`.

## Repo-wide pin sweep (card-class clauses ① and ②)

Swept by RULE, not by literal: every string literal in `git ls-files` (ts/mts/mjs/js/json/md/mdx/yml, release-owned trees excluded) that the OLD pattern refuses and the NEW one accepts. That gave 586 raw hits, triaged by hand to the package-id ones. Every same-semantic pin is flipped in this PR, and each flipped pin asserts the new behaviour rather than just dropping the old assertion:

| where | was | now |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.install-manifest-id.test.ts` | `com.4example.crm` a REFUSED row | an ADMITTED lit control: installs, and the registry receives the id as written. The refused reason is kept by `com.-example.crm` (hyphen-led) at the install and duplicate doors |
| `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-id-gate.test.ts` | `com.1acme.crm` a REFUSED row | a lit control: `200`, `manifestId` echoed, registered and filed as `com.1acme.crm.json`. The refused reason is kept by `com.-acme.crm` |
| `packages/cli/test/package-publish-manifest-id.test.ts` | `9foo.bar` in the relaxation table; `2024 App` derived `local.2024-app` and was refused | CLI and spec agree `9foo.bar`, `com.163.crm`, `local.2024-app` are ids. `2024 App` publishes: exit 0, both POSTs, wire `manifest_id` `local.2024-app`, not rewritten. Every slug the derivation can produce, from the name or the filename, parses |
| same file, anti-transcription control | the old pattern literal, described as "the schema's own pattern" | the widened literal |

Prose that stated the retired rule, made false by this change:
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.manifest-id-reverse-domain-required.ts`: the unreleased v18 prescription said "each opening with a letter". Reworded, and `registry.ts` regenerated with `gen:migration-registry` (not hand-edited).
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` and the `publish.ts` docblocks: they said `local.2024-app` is rejected, and listed `9foo.bar` as a shape the control plane refuses. These are comment and docs changes only.

## ⚠ Three PENDING release notes corrected (confirmation requested)

`check-empty-changeset` is red on this PR **by design**. This is its DELIBERATE CORRECTION class. Three pending changesets on `main` quote the refusal sentence verbatim in a `text` block, and this PR changes that sentence. Each block now quotes what the door will actually print. Nothing else in those notes moved: their "If you are refused" prose was already true under the widened rule.

- `.changeset/19417-install-door-parses-manifest-id.md`: the `pkg-a` refusal quote.
- `.changeset/19417-protocol-install-primitive-parses-manifest-id.md`: the `com.example.my_erp` refusal quote.
- `.changeset/19576-install-local-id-gate.md`: the `late-app` refusal quote.

Restoring them from base would ship a sentence no door prints. `skip-changeset` is deliberately **not** applied. **Please confirm these three edits in writing on this PR.** `Check Changeset` is not a required context.

## PM mechanism hypotheses — measured

- **H1, census.** None of the seven named files keeps its own copy of the rule. Each imports `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN`, `manifestIdRefusal` or `ManifestSchema`, or names them in a comment. Pins that refused a digit-led segment under another spelling: the three consumer rows above. Two producers still assume a letter-led last segment and prefix a digit-led name (`2fa` becomes `app-2fa`): `manifestIdSlug` (`packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`) and `deriveManifestId` (`packages/create-objectstack/src/rewrite-identity.ts`). Their output stays legal, so they are left as they are (Acceptance notes).
- **H2 holds, by reading the running code.** `deriveNamespaceFromPackageId` from the built spec gives: `com.example.2app` → `app`, `com.163.crm` → `crm`, `com.4example.crm` → `crm`, `com.example.123` → `null`. `namespace-prefix.test.ts` is green, and so is the metadata-protocol duplicate-door namespace test.
- **H3, objectui.** It has one local copy of the rule: `PACKAGE_ID_RE` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/packages-io.ts:244`, the same at the pin `f8a9d0fb05` and at `origin/main` `c3a26cc`. That copy requires a letter first, lets a later segment open with a digit, and admits underscores. The one new drift this PR adds: a digit-led FIRST segment (`9foo.bar`) is now legal in spec, and the Studio duplicate form's client check still refuses it. objectui does not import the spec constant, and nothing is removed or renamed, so the Console Pin Gate is unaffected.
- **H4, cloud.** NOT MEASURED: the repository is not attached to this container. The ruling's own reading (no DB-level pattern on `manifest_id`, cloud `b524051`) is carried as a lead.

## Verification, at head `a97a38db0`

- `@objectstack/spec`: full suite `vitest run --project local`: **540 files, 15800 passed, 2 todo**. `typecheck` (tsc, scripts, test layer): exit 0. Focused (`manifest`, `namespace-prefix`, `package-namespace`, `template-manifest-id`, `package-api`): 5 files, 188 passed.
- Consumer packages, one reading each:
  - metadata-protocol (`protocol.install-manifest-id`, `protocol.duplicate-package-target-namespace`): 32 passed, `typecheck` 0 errors.
  - runtime (`packages-install-manifest-id`, `artifact-granted-permissions`, `domain-handler-registry`): 101 passed.
  - cli (`init-manifest-id`, `nav-contribution-groups.package-id`, `package-publish-manifest-id`): 43 passed, `typecheck` 0 errors.
  - create-objectstack (`rewrite-identity`): 22 passed.
  - cloud-connection (`marketplace-install-local-id-gate`): 23 passed. It has no `typecheck` script.
- **Ablation**, a one-time proof run from the committed state through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Both legs landed on disk, and each restore was proven: blob == HEAD blob `f0913fa`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - Leg A put the pattern back to the leading-letter rule: `manifest.test.ts` went **5 red**. That is the two accepted digit rows, the shared-table door test, the `2fa` repair, and the every-suggestion-parses test.
  - Leg B put the old sentence clause back: **1 red**, the sentence pin.
  - Direction: turns red, as predicted.
- **Generated artifacts:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` reports all 15 up to date against a dist it built. The only regenerated file is `registry.ts`.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran` gives 115 derived, 110 run, 5 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. Of the 110 run, 109 exit 0 and `check-empty-changeset` exits 1 by design (above).
  - NOT MEASURED, prerequisite refusal (exit 3), needing a whole-workspace build: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`.
  - NOT MEASURED, no verdict: `check:type-check-debt`. Its whole-workspace re-measure was cut off by the batch timeout.
  - CI owns all five.

## Acceptance notes

None of these is filed. Each is an observation with no carrier (承接者:无).

- The scaffolders' prefix for a digit-led project name (`2fa` becomes `app-2fa` in `os init`; `123` becomes `com.example.app-123` in create-objectstack) is no longer required by the rule. Their comment "A segment must OPEN with a letter" now states a retired clause. Their output pins stay true as pins of the output.
- `os package publish`: the refusal remedy arms for DERIVED sources (`manifestIdRemedy`, `artifact-manifest-name` / `artifact-filename`) are now unreachable. A slug is always one legal segment, so a derived id always parses. The arm for a declared `manifest.id` stays live.
- objectui `PACKAGE_ID_RE` (H3): a second transcription of the rule. It was already looser (it admits underscores, which the server refuses loudly) and is now stricter on a digit-led first segment. Not exercised.
- `deriveNamespaceFromPackageId` drops a leading digit run, even when that run is part of a word (`com.example.2fa-leave` gives `fa_leave`). This is pre-existing, only a default, and the author can declare `namespace`.
- The Studio plugin id (`studio/plugin.zod.ts`, and `content/docs/plugins/development.mdx`) keeps its own leading-letter pattern. It is a different key under a different rule, not a package id.
